purpose: The five measurement events this site will record, defined precisely enough that whoever wires them cannot guess, plus an honest account of what is built, what is not, and why. Defining an event is not collecting it, and shipping a client is not collecting it either: the counter is written and shipped, the sink it would post to is not deployed, and every count in this file is empty on purpose.
why_nothing_is_sending: GitHub Pages is a static host, not a server for POST requests. The Python aggregate collector is implemented and tested but no production host or same-origin reverse proxy has been deployed.
The two configuration switches remain off; changing only one fails the build. There are no measured production totals to display.
The footer is generated from the collection state. It distinguishes site code from GitHub hosting logs and discloses the owner decision picker’s local-only storage.
Orders and conversions cannot be observed by this site. Only authorized first-party reports may populate the separate campaign ledger; an absent metric remains blank, not zero.

implementation.client: analytics/client.js, published verbatim as assets/analytics.js. Reads only canonical page IDs, explicitly marked link IDs and a fixed active-reading bucket. Uses same-origin application/json fetch with credentials omitted.
implementation.switch: data/config.json analytics and data/analytics-plan.json collection must agree. The endpoint path, runtime, notice and deployment flags are build-gated.
implementation.endpoint_source: analytics/collector.py is the canonical self-hosted endpoint. Stores atomic SQLite daily aggregates only. The older PHP and Worker raw-event examples are retired and return HTTP 410 without collecting.
implementation.guard: Schema agreement, deployment flags, same-origin endpoint, privacy wording, trusted link activations and banned identifier APIs are verified in build.py and regression tests.
implementation.verification: The Python HTTP/storage tests and JavaScript client contract tests exercise all four browser events and operator-only report import. These are local fixtures, not live visitor or Associates data.
implementation.what_is_not_shipped: No production endpoint, approved privacy review, verified Associates account access or Search Console property. No production events, conversion totals or revenue forecast.

privacy_rules: No analytics cookies, persistent reader IDs, browser storage, full URLs, referrers, query strings, IP addresses or user-agent strings are sent by the client.
DNT and Global Privacy Control are honored; prerendered and hidden-page time is excluded. Link events require trusted primary, keyboard or middle-button activations.
The collector stores UTC-day aggregate counters, not raw payloads or exact event timestamps. It rejects unknown fields, unknown page/link IDs and browser order/import events.

Network infrastructure sees connection metadata. The collector disables its own access log; actual host/proxy logging and retention must be reviewed separately. GitHub documents security IP logging for Pages.
The owner decision picker is separate from analytics. It saves choices locally in this browser only and offers explicit JSON export; nothing is submitted automatically.

events.name: page_view
events.fires_when: One event on the first visible, non-prerendered display of an eligible publication page. DNT, Global Privacy Control and browser automation suppress collection.
events.note: Application-defined aggregate event; not proof of a human visit, a unique session, a product recommendation, or a conversion.

events.name: outbound_click
events.fires_when: A trusted primary, keyboard or middle-button activation of an explicitly marked supplied product link. Counts interest, not an order; no navigation is blocked.
events.note: Application-defined aggregate event; not proof of a human visit, a unique session, a product recommendation, or a conversion.

events.name: article_engagement
events.fires_when: An individual published article or buying guide is visible and focused for 60 coarse one-second intervals. Background time does not advance the counter; this is engagement, not completion.
events.note: Application-defined aggregate event; not proof of a human visit, a unique session, a product recommendation, or a conversion.

events.name: comparison_interaction
events.fires_when: A trusted activation of a marked product-detail link from the comparison page, not merely a table impression.
events.note: Application-defined aggregate event; not proof of a human visit, a unique session, a product recommendation, or a conversion.

events.name: affiliate_report_import
events.fires_when: An authorized aggregate first-party report is explicitly imported into data/campaign-ledger.json. It is never accepted by the browser collector.
events.note: Operator-only report import. A click is not an order.

campaign_ledger.note: Started empty on purpose, per the brief's 'empty but well-defined campaign ledger'. A row may only be added from an authorised first-party report. No conversion score and no revenue forecast is presented anywhere in this repository.
campaign_ledger.why_empty: No authorized report has been imported and production collection is off. Test fixtures never enter the publication ledger.

prerequisites.owner_action: Select and deploy a durable HTTPS runtime and a same-origin /api/analytics/events route for the Python collector.
prerequisites.why: GitHub Pages cannot run the collector. Repository permissions do not provide a hosting account or DNS control.

prerequisites.owner_action: Review actual host/proxy logs, retention and the visitor notice; pass both collection switches and end-to-end tests together.
prerequisites.why: The deployment and privacy statement must describe the same behavior.

prerequisites.owner_action: Confirm intended listings and the selected tracking ID in Associates Central, test one enrolled Special Link per product, then import an authorized report.
prerequisites.why: shopnow047c-20 is recorded as user-provided, not confirmed active or applied to any supplied link.
